subject: Proposal: Rolling Net60 with Dynamic Credit Collar for Orion Biotech
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionbio.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary extension to Net60 + credit collar

Hi Stephanie / Laura —

Thanks again for the quick MSA turnaround (we received the DocuSign copy yesterday). As Orion scales usage in Q3/Q4 we need a short-term flexibility plan on payments while we transition an internal billing refresh. Specifically: could Redwood temporarily move us from Net30 to Net60 for three invoice cycles, paired with a dynamic credit collar tied to usage velocity?

Key notes from our side:
- We can share VAT registration and proof of EU entity decisions (attached a worksheet of the tax docs we have).
- Orion is comfortable with a credit ceiling of $400k for the pilot but would like the ceiling to automatically step up to $600k if 3 consecutive months of usage exceed the forecast by >20%.
- We would accept milestone-triggered reserves (10% holdback on large invoices) while the longer Net60 window is active.

Are these tolerable from Redwood’s risk/finance perspective? Happy to jump on a 30-minute call this week to align.

Thanks,
Amy
Amy Li
Procurement Manager, Orion Biotech
amy.li@orionbio.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: tax-evidence-orion.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension to Net60 + credit collar

Hi Amy —

Appreciate the clear asks and the tax doc worksheet — that helps. Short answer: we can do a pilot Net60 with a dynamic credit collar, but finance needs:

- Signed SOW or usage forecast to lock the initial $400k ceiling.
- Weekly visibility feed (CSV or API) so our billing ops can monitor velocity and trigger the step-up rule automatically.
- VAT/Tax evidence for any EU invoicing to avoid cross-border retention.

I'll loop Marcus from Finance and Laura from Revenue Ops to sort the mechanics. Can you share the forecast CSV by end of day Wednesday? If you prefer a call, propose Wed 11am PT.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-payment-schedule.xlsx (template)
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension to Net60 + credit collar

Hi Amy —

Thanks for the forecast earlier (reviewed). A couple of points from Finance to make the approval process cleaner:

1) Credit collar mechanics we propose:
   - Pilot period: 3 invoice cycles (approx 90 days)
   - Initial ceiling: $400,000 (requires signed forecast + MSA acknowledgement)
   - Auto-step rule: if 3 consecutive 30-day windows exceed forecast by >20%, ceiling increases to $600,000 automatically; Finance will require daily usage snapshots to verify spikes.
   - Holdback: 10% retention on invoices > $50k until the end of pilot (applies only to the invoice amount above $50k).

2) Risk mitigations needed up front:
   - Payment contact and ACH details for automated pulls if autopay is enabled (procurement ok with this?).
   - VAT validation for EU entity — if Orion wants Redwood to route EU invoices to EU entity, we need their VAT ID and a signed statement of tax residency (tax-evidence-orion.xlsx looks good but we'll need original docs).
   - A one-time onboarding fee can be levied if we need to increase monitoring/ops headcount; suggest $7,500 (waivable if DocuSign & forecast are in by Sept 1).

If you can confirm these, I can draft a one-page addendum to the MSA and share for signatures this week.

- Marcus
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

---Original message quoted---
From: Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orionbio.com, daniel.park@orionbio.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension to Net60 + credit collar

Marcus / Stephanie —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Orion: 
- ACH autopay: procurement prefers to keep control; they're open to scheduled ACH pulls if there's a prior notice window (48 hours) and an escalation path.
- VAT docs: we'll send certified copies of the VAT registration and a signed residency attestation by end of day Friday.
- Onboarding fee: understood; can you mark it as refundable upon successful completion of the pilot? That would help internal approvals.

Daniel (CFO) is on cc and indicated he can approve the refundable fee and the pilot but asked for Redwood to add a clause that allows Redwood to revert to Net30 with 30 days' notice if payment behavior deteriorates (late payments > 2 in a 90-day window).

We'll get you the VAT files and a final forecast CSV tomorrow. Can we aim to have an addendum ready for signatures by Sept 2?

Thanks,
Amy
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orionbio.com>, Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension to Net60 + credit collar

Daniel / Amy —

Thanks for confirming. We can do the refundable onboarding fee and the 30-day revert clause you requested. Proposed next steps on our side:

- Marcus will draft a one-page addendum with the pilot dates, ceiling mechanics, retention details, and the revert clause.
- Laura will prepare the velocity-monitoring spec (CSV schema + API webhook) and a short ops runbook for your billing team.
- We will require: VAT docs, signed forecast CSV, and procurement ACH preferences (or explicit opt-out) before the addendum is executed.

If Orion can get the VAT docs + forecast by EOD Sept 1, we will route the addendum for signatures and aim to have DocuSign complete by Sept 2.

I'll attach a draft payment schedule for your review.

Best,
Stephanie

Attachment: orion_msa_signed_stub.pdf (DocuSign copy), proposed-payment-schedule.xlsx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@orionbio.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Addendum sent for signature — pilot goes live Sep 6

Amy —

Quick update: we received the VAT attestation and forecast CSV this morning (thank you). Marcus completed the addendum and I routed it through DocuSign — link below. Key summary:

- Pilot Net60 active for invoices dated Sep 6 through Dec 6 (3 invoice cycles).
- Initial ceiling $400k; auto-step to $600k if 3 consecutive 30-day windows exceed forecast >20%.
- 10% holdback on invoice amounts above $50k.
- Refundable onboarding fee $7,500 (refunded at pilot close if payment performance meets criteria).
- Redwood reserves right to revert to Net30 with 30 days' notice if Orion has 2+ late payments in 90 days.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/ORION-MSA-4529

Please sign when ready and we will enable the monitoring webhook on Sep 6. Welcome aboard — excited to support your Q4 ramp.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
